content.body:
Originally designed as an exploitation tank, the Sherman in it's original guise had a 75mm gun with excellent HE rounds. Unfortunately, due to the odd US doctrine that declared that enemy tanks were to be fought only with tank destroyers, little attention was paid to the Shermans AT capability, which was not fantastic due to a low velocity AP round. To counter the huge threat that this presented the Allies with, when encountering German tanks with excellent penetration performance and armour too good frontally to be vulnerable to the Shermans weaker 75mm gun, a crash program to refit the Sherman with the far superior 76.2mm M1a2 AT gun was undertaken almost immediately.
Control Variations: Driver spawns in buttoned. May use periscope, or unbutton with O key. Driver's normal gauges not even peripherally visible unless you press numpad 0 or Ins key to deliberately look at them. Gunner has no view slit, no range adjustment (gradations only). Crew 4 is radioman, has hull mg with no crosshair at all. Can unbutton with O key and still fire hull mg.
With the better gun, the Sherman M4a3(76) is a very good medium tank. The high silhouette does pose a big target; conversely it improves visibility on the battlefield for the commander and it's much easier to find a hull-down position and still fire over the protection of the berm in front of your hull. Expect that you will be outranged in gun duels against 88mm-armed Tiger tanks should you stumble across one of these monsters. Work in teams and use cover to keep encounter ranges shorter where possible, as your gun will definately hurt Tigers out to around 1km, and is very deadly at 500 meters.
For a medium tank, it is fast and maneuverable with good turret speed to give you a bit more of an advantage in short to medium range engagements, you might look to get closer when possible ... where you can to exploit the excellent performance of the M79 ammo which does not have the advantages of a HE filler (it is solid shot) but it can definately hurt opposing armour at medium ranges (Tiger tanks will still be hardest to deal with) ... even the Tigers will have to stand off at long range to resist this upgunned Sherman. Don't let them, go and hunt them down with some friends.
